title: Implement Analytics Dashboard, Theme Toggle, Advanced Sorting, Featured Listings, Reviews, Favoriting & Recently Viewed

requirements.summary: Create analytics dashboard page with interactive charts for sales trends, view counts, and engagement metrics
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard displays sales trends chart showing listing activity over selected time period
View counts chart shows total views and unique visitors
Engagement metrics display saves, cart adds, and chat initiations
Time range selector allows switching between 7, 30, and 90-day periods
Charts update dynamically when time range changes

file_operations.description: Replace existing analytics display with interactive charts showing sales trends, view counts, and engagement metrics. Add time range selector (7/30/90 days) that updates all charts dynamically. Use recharts library for chart components with responsive design.

Update the insights API hook to accept timeRange parameter and fetch detailed analytics data including sales trends array, view counts, and engagement metrics (saves, cart adds, chat initiations) from the backend.
Create a recharts-based line chart component displaying sales trends over time with date on x-axis and listing count on y-axis. Support responsive sizing and tooltip on hover.
Create a recharts-based bar chart component showing total views and unique visitors metrics with clear labeling and responsive design.
Create a grid of metric cards displaying saves count, cart adds count, and chat initiations count with icons and trend indicators.
Create a button group component for selecting time ranges (7, 30, 90 days) with active state styling and click handlers.
Ensure the /insights route is properly registered and accessible from navigation. The route should already exist based on existing InsightsPage, verify it loads the updated analytics dashboard.

requirements.summary: Add CSV export functionality to analytics dashboard
acceptanceCriteria: Export button appears on analytics dashboard
Clicking export generates CSV file with all visible analytics data
CSV includes headers and properly formatted data rows
Downloaded file is named with timestamp (e.g., analytics-2024-01-15.csv)

file_operations.description: Add an Export to CSV button in the page header that triggers CSV generation and download of current analytics data.

Create utility function that converts analytics data (sales trends, view counts, engagement metrics) into CSV format with proper headers and data rows, then triggers browser download with timestamped filename (analytics-YYYY-MM-DD.csv).

requirements.summary: Implement dark/light theme toggle with persistence across all pages
acceptanceCriteria: Theme toggle button accessible in user profile or top navigation
Clicking toggle switches between light and dark themes instantly
Theme preference persists across browser sessions
All pages and components respect the selected theme
Theme transitions are smooth without flash of unstyled content

file_operations.description: Add ThemeToggle component to the top navigation bar, positioned near the user avatar dropdown for easy access across all pages.
Ensure ThemeToggle component is visible in the profile settings section for users who prefer accessing theme settings from their profile.

Verify the existing useTheme hook properly persists theme preference to cookies and applies the dark class to document root. Ensure theme hydration happens before first paint to prevent flash of unstyled content.
Verify the existing ThemeToggle button component provides smooth instant switching with sun/moon icons and proper accessibility labels.

Verify all CSS custom properties for light and dark themes are properly defined and that theme transitions are smooth. Ensure no flash of unstyled content by loading theme preference before React hydration.

requirements.summary: Add advanced sorting options including relevance, price, newest, popularity, condition, and distance
acceptanceCriteria: Sort dropdown menu displays all seven sorting options
Relevance sort uses scoring algorithm based on user signals
Price sorts work in ascending and descending order
Newest sort orders by creation timestamp
Popularity sort considers views, saves, and transaction count
Condition sort orders from Like New to Well-Used
Distance sort calculates proximity to user's campus location

file_operations.description: Expand existing SORT_OPTIONS array to include all seven options: relevance, priceLowToHigh, priceHighToLow, newestFirst, popularity, conditionQuality, and distance. Update applySorting function to implement each sorting algorithm, including relevance scoring based on user signals (saved, viewed, searched), popularity scoring using views/saves/transactions, condition quality ordering (likeNew > good > fair > wellUsed), and distance calculation from user's campus coordinates.
Update the sort dropdown to display all seven sorting options with clear labels and ensure the selected sort is properly highlighted and applied to search results.
Update the saved listings toolbar to include all seven sorting options in the sort dropdown, ensuring consistency with search page sorting.
Ensure search results respect the selected advanced sort option and that the sorting is applied correctly when listings are filtered by category, price range, or other criteria.
Apply the selected sort option from SavedToolbar to the saved listings display, ensuring all sorting algorithms work correctly on the saved items grid.

requirements.summary: Create featured/spotlight sections displaying promoted listings with distinct visual styling
acceptanceCriteria: Featured section appears prominently on home page above regular listings
Featured listings have special badge or border indicating promoted status
Admin or sellers can mark listings as featured through backend
Featured listings rotate or display in priority order
Featured section is responsive and works on mobile devices

file_operations.description: Add FeaturedSection component prominently near the top of the home page, positioned above trending and recommended sections to maximize visibility.

Update existing FeaturedSection component to display listings marked as featured with distinct visual styling (special badge, gradient border, or highlighted background). Sort featured listings by priority score or timestamp. Ensure responsive horizontal scrolling on mobile devices.

Add support for featured listing styling when a listing has featured status. Display a Featured badge icon and apply special border or background gradient to distinguish promoted listings from regular ones.
Display featured listings at the top of search results with distinct styling, separated from regular results by visual divider or special section heading.

requirements.summary: Implement review and rating system for sellers with reputation scores
acceptanceCriteria: After completing a transaction, buyers can submit a rating (1-5 stars) and optional review text
Seller profiles display average rating and total review count
Listing pages show seller's reputation score prominently
Reviews are visible on seller profile page with timestamp and rating
Reputation score updates immediately after new review submission

file_operations.description: Create a modal dialog for submitting seller reviews after transaction completion. Include 1-5 star rating selector, optional review text area with character limit, and submit button with validation.
Create a card component displaying a single review with reviewer name, star rating visualization, review text, and timestamp formatted as relative time.
Create a list component displaying all reviews for a seller, showing ReviewCard components with pagination or load-more functionality for sellers with many reviews.
Create React Query hooks for fetching seller reviews (getSellerReviews), submitting new reviews (addSellerReview), and calculating average ratings from review data.

Display seller reputation score prominently near seller name using SellerRating component. Show average rating and total review count. Add a View All Reviews button that navigates to seller profile reviews section.

Add a Reviews section displaying SellerReviewsList component showing all reviews received by the user. Display average rating prominently at top with total count. For viewing other users' profiles, render their reviews in a similar section.
Ensure the existing SellerRating component properly displays 5-star rating visualization with numeric average and transaction count from the updated review system.

requirements.summary: Add favoriting functionality with optimistic UI updates
acceptanceCriteria: Heart icon appears on listing cards for favoriting/unfavoriting
Clicking heart immediately updates UI (optimistic update)
Favorites persist across sessions
Saved page displays all favorited listings
Users can unfavorite from listing cards or saved page

file_operations.description: Verify the existing heart icon button uses useOptimisticToggleSave hook for instant UI feedback. Ensure the heart icon is visible on all listing cards (home, search, saved pages) with proper filled/outlined states.
Verify the existing optimistic save/unsave hook properly updates UI immediately before backend call completes, handles errors by reverting state, and shows toast notifications for success/failure.
Ensure saved page displays all favorited listings in a filterable grid with heart icons that allow unfavoriting. Verify empty state prompts users to browse and save listings.
Verify existing useSaveListing and useUnsaveListing hooks properly persist favorites via backend actor methods (saveListing, unsaveListing) and invalidate saved listings query on success.
Ensure listing detail page has a prominent heart button for favoriting/unfavoriting with optimistic updates and proper visual feedback.

requirements.summary: Create comparison tool for viewing up to 3 listings side-by-side
acceptanceCriteria: Users can select listings for comparison via checkbox or button
Compare button appears when 2-3 listings are selected
Comparison view displays selected listings in columns
Key attributes shown: price, condition, description, seller rating, meetup locations
Users can remove listings from comparison and add different ones
Maximum of 3 listings can be compared simultaneously

file_operations.description: Create a React hook managing comparison state with functions to add/remove listings (max 3), check if compare mode is active, and persist selected listing IDs to sessionStorage.

Create a checkbox component overlay for listing cards that allows selecting items for comparison. Show checkmark when selected and disable when 3 items already selected (unless this listing is already selected).
Create a floating action button that appears when 2-3 listings are selected, showing count badge. Clicking navigates to comparison page with selected listing IDs as URL parameters.

Create comparison page displaying selected listings in responsive columns (side-by-side on desktop, stacked cards on mobile). Show key attributes in aligned rows: image, title, price, condition badge, description excerpt, seller rating with stars, and meetup locations list. Include remove buttons for each listing and exit comparison button.
Add ComparisonCheckbox overlay to listing cards when comparison mode is active. The checkbox should appear in top-left corner without blocking other card interactions.
Add compare mode toggle button to search filters bar. When active, show ComparisonCheckbox on all listing cards and display CompareButton when 2-3 items selected.
Register /compare route that lazy-loads ComparisonPage component for side-by-side listing comparison.

requirements.summary: Implement recently viewed tracker displaying last viewed listings
acceptanceCriteria: Viewing a listing detail page automatically adds it to recently viewed
Recently viewed strip appears on home page showing last 10 viewed items
Dedicated recently viewed page accessible from user profile or navigation
Recently viewed items persist across browser sessions
Users can clear recently viewed history
Most recent items appear first in the list

file_operations.description: Verify the existing recently-viewed tracking call properly adds current listing to recently viewed history when page loads using the recentlyViewed persistence layer.
Verify existing persistence functions properly track up to 20 recently viewed listings sorted by timestamp with most recent first, stored in localStorage with deduplication.

Verify existing horizontal scrollable strip component displays last 10 recently viewed listings with thumbnails on home page. Ensure listings are fetched from backend using listing IDs from persistence layer.
Ensure RecentlyViewedStrip component is visible on home page, positioned prominently above or below featured listings section.
Create dedicated page displaying all recently viewed listings (up to 20) in a grid layout with clear history button at the top. Show empty state when no items have been viewed.
Register /recently-viewed route that lazy-loads RecentlyViewedPage component for viewing full recently viewed history.
Add Recently Viewed link to user avatar dropdown menu for easy navigation to full recently viewed history page.
